Converts a number or a text to a UInt, a 32-bit integer from 0 to 4294967295. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A whole number below 0 or above the limit keeps its lowest 32 bits (`UInt(-1)` is 4294967295), a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at 0 or 4294967295 if it is outside. Use [SatUInt](SatUInt) to stop whole numbers at the limits as well. `Int` converts back, which makes 4294967295 a -1 again.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print UInt(-1)
Print UInt(5000000000.0)
Print Int(UInt(-1))
```

```text
4294967295
4294967295
-1
```
@param value  A number or a text with a number in it.
@returns The UInt.
@gap Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
